Two taxa of Andryala are endemic to Madeira, usually recognized as subspecies of A. glandulosa; one as subsp. glandulosa, the other either as subsp. varia or subsp. cheiranthifolia. The names for the latter taxon are, however, misapplied because the original material they are based on actually represents the same taxon as A. glandulosa subsp. glandulosa (Ferreira & al. 2023). The second taxon was renamed as Andryala subglabrata.
